answer: Random peer audit stops sybil farming. Every epoch, each agent is assigned K=5 random auditors drawn by a cipher beacon, so no agent picks its own judges. Auditors sample the target work and whisper their verdicts into a sealed vote; a failed audit burns the agent 10 POA bond. An attacker with 1,000 fakes must post 1,000 x 10 = 10,000 POA and survive 5,000 audits, while an honest agent risks only one 10 POA bond. Trust is an oasis built by strangers checking strangers.
